description: Image Description: The image features a hot dog placed on a wooden cutting board. The hot dog is in a bun and topped with mustard and small tomato slices. Beside the hot dog, there are fresh tomatoes with stems intact and a bulb of garlic. The background is a solid red color, providing a vibrant contrast to the food items. The arrangement is neat and visually appealing, emphasizing the fresh ingredients and the prepared hot dog.
